clips.title: The story
paras: Bloodfeather harpies threaten the Oracle Glade on northwestern Teldrassil, where Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak guards the ancient Oracle Tree. After harpies kill a runner bound for Darnassus, Arynia calls for their nests to be thinned and their belts brought back as proof.

Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak watches over the Oracle Glade with an escort of warriors. The sacred retreat centers on the colossal Oracle Tree, an ancient rooted among Teldrassil's boughs. Bloodfeather harpies have spread through the surrounding canopy, nesting in the hollows and threatening anyone who comes near.

A runner carrying an urgent report from the Oracle Tree never reaches Darnassus. Bloodfeather harpies ambush and kill the messenger before the runner can leave the glade. Arynia calls on you to thin their flock and bring back Bloodfeather belts as proof that their nests have been weakened.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was dispatched with a small group of Sentinels here to protect the Oracle Tree from the harpies that have made nests all around the glade. Little by little we are trying to push them back.
When the Oracle Tree attempted to send a runner to Darnassus with a report, the messenger was attacked and killed by a group of the harpies.
If you feel up to the task, go to their nests, slay them, and return their belts to me as proof of your deeds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, friend, but I have faith that you will not fail in this task.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, friend. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... But I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.
I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
